integrity: The proof conditions on the first-pivot rank, derives the exact conditional mean from independent recursive subtrees, proves monotonicity across symmetric root imbalances, and evaluates the mixed moment with explicit finite harmonic sums. The exact path-length variance is independently anchored in the cited full primary paper. Exhaustive permutation enumeration replays every finite identity through n=9.
scientific_limitations: The model is the random-permutation binary search tree; biased or median-of-sample split laws need different formulas.
The monotonicity statement is regression in conditional mean, not stochastic ordering of the full conditional path-length laws.
The covariance follows by an elementary summation from standard root decomposition and path-length moments, so equivalent unpublished or textbook-level derivations remain a residual originality risk.
title: Squared root imbalance has an exact cubic covariance with random-BST path length
